axis: Detect AI-slop patterns: templated openings, em-dash overuse, three-pillar lists, false-balance phrasing.

patterns: ^.{0,200}\b(In an era where|It is widely (recognized|acknowledged)|As we (look to|move into)|In today.s (rapidly|fast-paced))\b
questions.question: Zero template openings ('In an era where', 'It is widely recognized')?

patterns: \b(three pillars|three core (principles|tenets|reasons)|3 ways to|three things you need)\b
questions.question: No 'three pillars / three reasons / three things' template?

patterns: \b(on (the )?one hand,?.*on the other hand|that said|with that being said|all things considered)\b
questions.question: No 'on one hand … on the other hand' false-balance hedging?
Em-dash density ≤ 3/kw (overuse is an AI-slop signal)?

patterns: \b(In closing|To wrap up|As a final thought|To bring this together|To put a bow on)\b
questions.question: No fluffy closings ('In closing', 'To wrap up', 'As a final thought')?
No '## Introduction', '## Conclusion', '## Overview' template-cloned headers?
No 'Here are N X you need to Y' listicle scaffolding?

patterns: \b(drum ?roll please|and the answer is|here.s the kicker|wait for it)\b
questions.question: No drum-roll / reveal phrasing ('Drumroll please', 'And the answer is')?
